deep_dive.title: INC-MoE: Overlapping In-Network Collectives and Expert Computation for Expert-Parallel Mixture-of-Experts Inference
deep_dive.abstract: In expert-parallel mixture-of-experts (MoE) serving, dispatch moves tokens to the accelerators hosting their selected experts, and combine returns expert outputs to each token's owner. Both operations lie on the critical path and can dominate MoE layer latency in multi-node deployments. We present INC-MoE, an expert-parallel MoE layer that offloads dispatch and combine to the network switch and overlaps both collectives with each other and with expert computation. Dispatch uses in-network AllGather through switch-side multicast, while combine uses in-network ReduceScatter through switch-side reduction. Both collectives use message semantics between the end hosts and the switch. Because the in-network collectives load opposite directions of each link, executing them concurrently reduces bandwidth-bound communication time by $(N-2)/(2(N-1))$ relative to concurrent ring-based collectives: 33% for four ranks and 43% for eight.   INC-MoE partitions tokens into bands and processes them through a three-stage AllGather-feed-forward network (FFN)-ReduceScatter pipeline inside a single persistent kernel. At steady state, role-specialized thread blocks gather the next band, compute the current band, and reduce the previous band concurrently, overlapping both collectives with each other and with computation using device-side synchronization. INC-MoE integrates as a drop-in replacement for the MoE layer of vLLM. We evaluate it in an emulated four-node scale-out deployment with a dedicated accelerator emulating an in-network computing (INC) switch. On OLMoE prefill with four-way expert parallelism, INC-MoE reduces time to first token (TTFT) by up to 33% and increases throughput by up to 50% relative to vLLM's default collective path, while matching its outputs.

deep_dive.llm_tldr_en: Presents INC-MoE, an expert-parallel MoE layer that offloads token dispatch and combine to network switches via in-network AllGather and ReduceScatter, overlapping these collectives with each other and with expert computation to cut MoE latency.
deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 专家并行MoE推理中，token分发与结果合并位于关键路径，可能主导多节点部署下的层延迟。作者提出INC-MoE，将分发与合并卸载到网络交换机，分别以网内AllGather多播和ReduceScatter归约实现，并使这些集合通信彼此重叠并与专家计算重叠。该设计显著缓解了MoE层通信瓶颈，为集合通信与计算重叠优化提供了新范式。
